hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */src/*.py|src/*.py|*/scripts/*.py|scripts/*.py) bash scripts/lint_gateway_usage.sh ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; base="$(basename "$f" .py)"; case "$f" in */src/graph/nodes/*.py|src/graph/nodes/*.py) if [ "$base" != "__init__" ] && [ -f "tests/graph/nodes/test_${base}.py" ]; then python3 -m unittest "tests.graph.nodes.test_${base}"; fi ;; esac; }
